name: Presence
description: Presence (HERE) is a fixed-cap ERC-20 token on Ethereum. Maximum supply is hard-capped on-chain at 250,000,000 HERE; the contract has no fees, hooks, blocklists, or pausing.
notes: Official site: cp17.org. The token is deliberately separate from the book (thecardinalspromise.com) — do not cross-link them in listings. Fill in contract addresses after deployment before submitting to Etherscan token update, CoinGecko, or a Uniswap token list. Etherscan requires a 32x32 PNG icon — use assets/logo-32.png.
